text: libsail depends on indexmap, memchr and feisty, plus memmap2 behind the mmap feature. feisty replaced rand, which was only there to shuffle an index vector and seed the unseeded permute()/sample(), both since removed; feisty has no dependencies where rand pulled seven. sail still takes rand for the one u64 it draws when --seed is absent; std::hash::RandomState would cover that call if the dependency is ever worth dropping.
